turns.speaker: User
turns.text: I recently moved to Berlin for a new job at Acme Corp.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Welcome to Berlin! What role are you starting at Acme Corp?

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: I joined as a senior software engineer. My manager is Sarah Chen. The onboarding has been smooth.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Just got back from visiting my parents in Kyiv for the holidays. It was a long trip.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: How was the trip back home?

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Really good. My sister Olena came from Lviv to join us. We had a great time together.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: Our team at Acme is building a new payment processing microservice.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Interesting project. What tech stack are you using?

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: We chose Go for the backend and PostgreSQL as the database. The deadline is end of Q2.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: I have some big news — I decided to leave Acme Corp. I got an offer from Globex International.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Congratulations! That sounds like a great opportunity. When do you start?

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: I start at Globex next Monday. It's a promotion to staff engineer, which I'm really excited about.

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: I've been playing chess to unwind ever since moving to Berlin.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Nice! Do you play at a club or just online?

turns.speaker: User
turns.text: I joined the Berlin Chess Club three months ago and actually won my first tournament last weekend.
